question: The Commission’s website detailing trade relations with Israel1 outlines various statistics relating to the EU-Israel trade relationship (including through the use of graphs). The webpage acknowledges the policy of differentiation but does not specify or provide visual aids regarding the actual figures of the EU’s trade with illegal Israeli settlements.

The Commission has previously indicated that the EU imported approximately EUR 76.5 million worth of goods from the illegal settlements in 2025.2 The Commission has acknowledged that these statistics may underestimate actual imports of goods originating in illegal settlements due to mislabelling.
Will the Commission publish all statistics relating to trade with the illegal Israeli settlements on the Directorate-General for Trade and Economic Security webpage concerning trade with Israel?
